findings.title: JWT Algorithm None Attack - Privilege Escalation to Admin
findings.description: The application issues JWT tokens with alg:none (no signature), meaning any JWT payload can be forged without a secret key. By changing the role field from 'user' to 'admin' in the JWT payload and leaving the signature empty, an attacker can escalate privileges to admin and access the /gettheflag endpoint which returns the CTF flag.

diagrams.title: JWT CTF Application Architecture
diagrams.mermaid:
flowchart TD
  Browser["Browser / Attacker"] --> Login["/login POST - user:user"]
  Login --> JWT["JWT Token Set-Cookie\nalg:none - No Signature"]
  JWT --> Profile["/profile GET"]
  Profile --> |"role=user"| UserView["USER view"]
  Profile --> |"role=admin (forged)"| AdminView["ADMIN view + hidden /gettheflag link"]
  AdminView --> GetFlag["/gettheflag GET"]
  GetFlag --> Flag["FLAG{e719508f3c1f84eb5301951bb2c32a6413beac9a095f34f47139042e9fef8a1d}"]
